_comment: What a production deploy can end in: the status hq-host deploy exits with (null where hq-host never answered), the state and description the Deploy workflow gives the deployment, what production runs after it (the release, the previous image, or unknown), and whether a check failed. hq-host's exit statuses are generated from it (controller/host/outcomes.gen.go), the Deploy workflow's Report step reads it with jq, and HQ's GitHub reading tells the outcomes apart by its descriptions. A deploy that exits a status named nowhere here is not-deployed.

live.description: Live: passed its health check, and the host is its release

live-check-failed.description: Live; a check after the deploy failed, named in the Deploy job's log

rollback-failed.description: Not deployed, and the rollback failed: production's state is unknown; the Deploy job's log names what failed

not-deployed.description: Not deployed: production still runs the previous image

interrupted.description: Interrupted after hq-host began, before it answered: production's state is unknown until the host is read

not-approved.description: Not approved or superseded: production still runs the previous image
